setup.relevance: Relevance judgments for the CareerLens evaluation. They are RULES over structured fields of the dataset, fixed before any system was compared. role_family is the dataset's own label (job_title_short); it is NOT part of the text the engine searches (Title, Skills, Location, Company), so a role query is not trivially solved by matching its own label. Grade 2 (relevant) = every rule in 'must' and 'should' holds; grade 1 (partially relevant) = only 'must' holds. Precision, recall and AP count grade 2 only; nDCG uses both grades. Rule keys: role_family (one of), country (one of), company (case-insensitive, one of), skills_all (listing lists every skill), skills_any (lists at least one). Limits: relevance is defined by metadata, not by a human reading each posting; the 'skills only' queries are close to circular because skills are what the Skills zone indexes. Split: within each query type the judged queries alternate dev/test (fixed before tuning). Weights are tuned on dev only; test is held out.

explanations.P@K: Precision@K: of the top K retrieved listings, how many are relevant? (relevant in top K / K)
explanations.R@K: Recall@K: of ALL relevant listings, how many were retrieved in the top K? (relevant in top K / all relevant). It is small when there are thousands of relevant listings, so the recall ceiling is shown.
explanations.AP@K: Average Precision@K: rewards putting relevant listings early; the mean of Precision at each rank where a relevant listing appears, divided by min(K, all relevant).
